seoDescription: Meet our tailoring workshop in Belgrade — experience from film sets and theatre stages, made to measure from the first conversation to the last stitch.

hero.title: About
hero.subtitle: Clothing made to your measurements, by a master's hand.
hero.imageLabel: Wide photo of the workshop: cutting table, fabrics, dress form
hero.imageAlt: Button press, scissors and brass buttons on fabric in the workshop

story.title: A traditional craft,
paragraphs: Behind the tailoring workshop is Slađana Guslov, who has more than 20 years of experience and the wish to turn what you have imagined into reality. That is her in a nutshell — and if you want to know more about her, and see how easily she understands what you want and helps you wear it, the best thing is to visit her at the workshop.
story.imageLabel: Portrait photo: work in progress, sewing detail
story.imageAlt: Pattern pieces hanging in the workshop

founder.title: Meet
founder.quote: My workshop is my second home, and there is no greater satisfaction than when a client leaves happy because I helped her feel better in her clothes.
founder.imageLabel: Portrait: Slađana in the workshop, natural light
founder.imageAlt: Slađana at a fitting with a client

film.title: From film sets
film.text: In my work I have always looked for bigger challenges, and they came through collaborations with film and theatre productions and work on all kinds of costumes — they often have to be complex and true to their period, yet survive rehearsals and performances. I have made costumes for theatre, film, music videos, concerts and commercials, working with costume designers such as [Bojana Nikitović](https://sr.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D0%BE%D1%98%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%9D%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%9B), [Milica Kolarić](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm2379946/), [Dragica Laušević](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm3691699/), [Lena Antić](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm16107524/), [Jana Zaharijević](https://janazaharijevic.com/) and [Kristina Kostić](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm6566160/).

items.title: It all starts with a conversation
items.text: Before we take a single measurement, we want to understand the occasion, the style and how you will wear the piece.

items.title: Measurements, not sizes
items.text: We don't alter ready-made patterns. Every cut is made from scratch, to your measurements.

items.title: Details are part of the cut
items.text: Finishing seams, lining, buttons — what you don't notice at first glance is what makes the difference.

items.title: Honest advice
items.text: We will recommend the fabric and cut that suit you, but the final word is always yours.
